description: Email subscription system (item 11): subscribers table migration, subscribe API route, EmailSubscribeForm component, add to home page, add subscriber count to admin dashboard stats, send notification email to subscribers when a paper is published via PATCH. Depends on existing redis.ts and email.ts patterns. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 except: it also adds subscriber count to the admin dashboard (same file as FEAT-002 item 8 analytics) — implement FEAT-004 after FEAT-002 to avoid merge conflicts on admin/page.tsx.
steps: Subscribers migration: Create /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/supabase/migrations/003_subscribers.sql. Content: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscribers (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), email text NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), confirmed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true); ALTER TABLE subscribers ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY "Anyone can subscribe" ON subscribers FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true); CREATE POLICY "Admins can manage subscribers" ON subscribers FOR ALL USING (is_admin());

Database types: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/types/database.ts. Add three new types after the ContactMessages types: export type SubscribersRow = { id: string; email: string; created_at: string; confirmed: boolean }; export type SubscribersInsert = { id?: string; email: string; created_at?: string; confirmed?: boolean }; export type SubscribersUpdate = { id?: string; email?: string; confirmed?: boolean }. In the Database type's public.Tables object, add: subscribers: { Row: SubscribersRow; Insert: SubscribersInsert; Update: SubscribersUpdate; Relationships: [] }.

Redis ratelimit: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/lib/redis.ts. Add export const subscribeRatelimit = new Ratelimit({ redis, limiter: Ratelimit.slidingWindow(3, '60 m'), prefix: 'rl:subscribe' }); at the end of the file.

Email helper: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/lib/email.ts. Add new exported function sendSubscriberNotification(paperTitle: string, paperUrl: string, subscriberEmails: string[]): Promise<void>. If subscriberEmails is empty, return early. Create Resend client lazily. Send email from RESEND_FROM_EMAIL to RESEND_FROM_EMAIL (send to self) with bcc: subscriberEmails, subject: `New paper available: ${paperTitle}`, html: a simple HTML email with a link to paperUrl. Use escapeHtml for the title in the HTML.

Subscribe API route: Create /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/app/api/subscribe/route.ts. Import NextRequest, NextResponse from 'next/server'. Import z from 'zod'. Import createAdminClient from '@/lib/supabase/admin'. Import subscribeRatelimit from '@/lib/redis'. Define SubscribeSchema = z.object({ email: z.email().max(254) }) — note: z.email() is top-level in Zod v4. Export async POST function: (1) get IP from x-forwarded-for or x-real-ip header; (2) rate limit check with subscribeRatelimit.limit(ip) — return 429 if exceeded; (3) parse JSON body; (4) validate with SubscribeSchema.safeParse — return 400 if invalid; (5) insert into subscribers table via adminClient; (6) if error.code === '23505' (unique violation), return 200 with message 'Already subscribed!'; (7) on other error return 500; (8) on success return 200 with message 'Subscribed successfully!'.

EmailSubscribeForm component: Create /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/components/EmailSubscribeForm.tsx as a 'use client' component. State: email (string), status ('idle'|'loading'|'success'|'error'), message (string). On submit: POST /api/subscribe with { email }, show success/error message. UI: a small card with heading 'Stay updated', subtitle 'Get notified when new papers are added', an email input, and a subscribe button. Use brand colors for the button. Show the response message inline. Keep it compact and visually consistent with the rest of the public pages.

Add EmailSubscribeForm to home page: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/app/(public)/page.tsx. Import EmailSubscribeForm using dynamicImport (same pattern as SearchBar and FilterPanel — ssr: false with a simple skeleton loading fallback). Add it between the closing of the hero and the start of the filters div:
}>
.

Add subscriber count to admin dashboard: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/app/(admin)/admin/page.tsx. In the Promise.all, add: db.from('subscribers').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }). Destructure subscribersRes from the Promise.all result. Extract subscribersCount = subscribersRes.count ?? 0. Add to the stats array: { label: 'Subscribers', value: subscribersCount, href: '/admin', color: 'bg-pink-50 text-pink-700' }.

Subscriber notification on paper publish: Edit /home/hysterical/Desktop/PQ/src/app/api/papers/[id]/route.ts. Add import for sendSubscriberNotification from '@/lib/email'. In the PATCH handler, after the successful update (after `return NextResponse.json({ data })`... actually before it — after the update succeeds and `data` is available), check if parsed.data.status === 'published'. If so, fire-and-forget a promise: void (async () => { try { const { data: subs } = await adminClient.from('subscribers').select('email'); const emails = (subs ?? []).map(s => s.email); const siteUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ?? 'https://pq-questions26.onrender.com'; await sendSubscriberNotification(data.title, `${siteUrl}/papers/${data.id}`, emails); } catch (e) { console.error('[PATCH /api/papers/[id]] subscriber notification failed:', e); } })(). This must be placed BEFORE the return statement so it fires (fire-and-forget — do not await).
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/003_subscribers.sql exists with correct CREATE TABLE and RLS policies
SubscribersRow, SubscribersInsert, SubscribersUpdate are exported from src/types/database.ts
POST /api/subscribe returns 200 with success message for valid email
POST /api/subscribe returns 429 after 3 requests from same IP within an hour
POST /api/subscribe returns 200 with 'Already subscribed!' for duplicate email
EmailSubscribeForm component renders on the home page below the hero
Admin dashboard stats include 'Subscribers' count card
PATCH /api/papers/[id] sends subscriber notification email when status is set to 'published'
npm run build exits 0 with zero errors
findings: 1. supabase/migrations/003_subscribers.sql: created with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, RLS enabled, two policies: INSERT open to all, ALL for admins via is_admin(). 2. database.ts: SubscribersRow/Insert/Update types added after ContactMessages types; subscribers table added to Database.public.Tables with empty Relationships array. 3. redis.ts: subscribeRatelimit added using slidingWindow(3, '60 m') with prefix 'rl:subscribe'. 4. email.ts: sendSubscriberNotification exported; lazy Resend client; sends from RESEND_FROM_EMAIL to RESEND_FROM_EMAIL with bcc: subscriberEmails; returns early when array is empty; throws on Resend error. 5. /api/subscribe/route.ts: POST only; z.email().max(254) via Zod v4 top-level; IP from x-forwarded-for or x-real-ip; rate limit via subscribeRatelimit; 429 on limit exceeded; 400 on validation fail; 200 'Already subscribed!' on error.code==='23505'; 500 on other DB error; 200 'Subscribed successfully!' on success. 6. EmailSubscribeForm: 'use client'; email/status/message state; POSTs to /api/subscribe; shows success (green) or error (red) message inline; button shows 'Subscribing...' during load; disabled after success. 7. home page: EmailSubscribeForm imported via dynamicImport(ssr:false) with h-24 skeleton; rendered between hero </section> and filters div inside bg-white border-b div with max-w-3xl padding; wrapped in Suspense. 8. admin/page.tsx: Promise.all extended from 5 to 6 queries (adds subscribers count with head:true); subscribersCount = subscribersRes.count ?? 0; Subscribers stat card added with bg-pink-50 text-pink-700; stats grid updated to grid-cols-2/sm:grid-cols-3/lg:grid-cols-5 to accommodate 5 cards. 9. /api/papers/[id]/route.ts: sendSubscriberNotification imported from @/lib/email; fire-and-forget void (async()=>{...})() placed after update success check and BEFORE return statement; fetches all subscriber emails via adminClient; uses NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL env var with fallback. 10. npm run build and npm run lint both exit 0. CROSS-FEAT INTEGRATION (convergence): /api/papers/[id]/route.ts seam verified — GET, PATCH (with subscriber notification fire-and-forget), and DELETE all present and functioning. admin/page.tsx seam verified — subscriber count (FEAT-004, 6th query in Promise.all) coexists with analytics (FEAT-002, queries 4 and 5). npm run build — exit 0. npm run lint — exit 0. npm run test:unit — 30/30 passed.
